lexicon.content:
ARC LEVEL

ARC stands for Active Reality Control. It is a measurement system devised by DDM Inc., and it does not measure strength, intelligence or magical power. It measures how real something is.

Every person, object and concept in existence carries an ARC value. The higher the value, the more real the thing is, and the more influence it exerts over reality around it. A 0 on the scale would be a non-concept, something that does not register as existing at all. A 5 would be a being most cultures would call a god.

THE SCALE IN PRACTICE:
1.0, an average human.
1.2, the minimum natural level required for someone to be eligible for a Contract.
3.0 to 4.2, the normal range for a Contractor.

KNOWN VALUES: Hana and Adam Valencia 3.5 while medicated, 4.2 raw. Luka Sutter 3.8. Johan Jakobsen 3.9. Fenrir 4.0. Dullahan 4.5. Richard Whitlock 4.6.

Dullahan and Whitlock both sit above the stated Contractor ceiling, and neither file explains why.

WHAT A HIGH ARC LOOKS LIKE FROM OUTSIDE: nothing dramatic. It is not an aura. It shows up as reality declining to argue. Coincidences fall the right way. Things that should not fit through a door fit through the door. A being with a high enough ARC does not break the rules so much as outrank them.

COMPATIBILITY NOTE: ARC is a DDM measurement and is not used, recognised or even known by anyone in California, Blackwood City or Solarton. It has no relationship to local supernatural classifications.
lexicon.name: ARC Level

lexicon.content:
<blackwolf_sigillo>
Project BlackWolf is still a live military secret. It was never declassified: it was terminated and sealed, and the paperwork that survives describes a programme of equipment trials. Inside the Supernatural Reserve Forces the number of people who know what Gamma-7 actually was is small and getting smaller, and none of them will say it out loud. Kaladin Nargathon and Marcus Thornfield are bound by that seal and do not discuss it, with each other least of all, because they were both there and neither needs telling.

One civilian knows, and it is not the one anybody would guess. It is Jasper Douglas-Bloodmoon.

He was a boy when Erik brought two soldiers into the house and made them family security, and he did what a curious child with a talent does: he went looking. He got into the Pentagon. He was not hunting classified material and had no idea what he was going to find. He wanted to know who the two silent men eating at his table actually were. He found Gamma-7: eight names, six of them dead, and two of them downstairs.

He has never told anyone. Not Erik, not Malachia, not Alyssa, and above all not Kaladin or Marcus. He was too young to understand what he was holding when he found it, and by the time he understood he had been holding it for years, which made saying it harder instead of easier. He knows what was done to them, and he knows they believe nobody knows.

What he does not know is what the programme was really reaching for. He read a file, and the file does not say. See the sealed entry on Velhati and Velskoll, which is a separate secret and a deeper one.
</blackwolf_sigillo>
lexicon.name: Project BlackWolf: il sigillo e l'unico civile che sa

lexicon.content:
<casa_della_longhouse>
Wulfnic, Ut e Zefir tengono una casa condivisa dall'epoca fondativa, nel senso antico della parola e non come figura retorica. Chi ci vive dentro non ci e' arrivato incontrando qualcuno. Ci e' arrivato in due modi, e vale la pena chiamarli come sono.

I DONI. Branchi di tutto il continente mandano donne al Re Lupo. E' la forma antica della legge, quella abolita per le Case nel primo Novecento, sopravvissuta intatta nel punto piu' alto della gerarchia. Un branco che manda una donna alla longhouse compra una considerazione che non si compra in nessun altro modo, e la donna e' cio' con cui si paga. Si chiamano doni perche' e' la parola che si usa. La parola descrive esattamente quello che sono.

LE VOLONTARIE. Credenti del Culto delle Living Sagas che si offrono. L'offerta e' sincera, nessuno le ha portate, e nessuna di loro si considera vittima di niente. Hanno pero' formato quella volonta' dentro una fede che venera l'uomo a cui si offrono, e chiamarlo un consenso libero richiede di non guardarlo troppo da vicino. Loro lo guarderebbero da vicino e direbbero di si' lo stesso, il che e' un fatto sul quale il mondo non ha una risposta pulita.

COME SONO TRATTATE. Bene, ed e' parte del problema piu' che una sua attenuazione. La casa provvede a loro per tutta la vita, nessuno le tocca contro la loro volonta', e chi vuole andarsene se ne va senza che nessuno la insegua. Un dono maltrattato sarebbe uno scandalo continentale. Un dono trattato bene resta un dono.

LA CONTRADDIZIONE, CHE IL MONDO NON RISOLVE. Wulfnic ha riformato la legge del diciannovesimo anno negli anni del voto alle donne, e continua a ricevere donne mandate da altri. Non e' ipocrisia nascosta e non e' un segreto: e' pubblico, e' tradizione, e nessuno nel continente ha l'autorita' per sollevare la questione con lui, perche' l'unica autorita' che potrebbe sollevarla e' lui. La riforma vale per le Case. La longhouse e' piu' vecchia delle Case.

L'unica persona al mondo che potrebbe alzarsi e dirglielo in faccia senza che il proprio corpo la tradisca e' sua nipote, che e' immune al comando degli Alpha. Non le e' mai venuto in mente di farlo.

COME SI SCRIVE IN SCENA. Come un fatto sociale, non come materiale erotico. Le donne della casa sono adulte, hanno nomi e opinioni, e la scena che le riduce a un arredamento ha sbagliato tono. La cosa interessante di questa istituzione non e' cosa ci succede dentro: e' che esiste, nel 2024, al vertice di una specie che si e' data una legge per non farlo piu'.
</casa_della_longhouse>
lexicon.name: La casa della Longhouse: doni e volontarie

lexicon.content:
<legge_del_diciannovesimo_anno>
Legge continentale, posta da Wulfnic Bloodmoon come Alpha of Alphas e vincolante per ogni branco del Nord America che lo riconosce, cioe' tutti. Nel suo diciannovesimo anno un'Omega di sangue nobile, Founding o Pureblood, viene presentata.

LA FORMA ANTICA. Nella versione originale il verbo era dare. L'Alpha della Casa sceglieva l'uomo e le consegnava l'Omega, e l'Omega era la parte della transazione di cui non si chiedeva il parere. Non era un abuso ai margini della norma, era la norma, e ha funzionato cosi' per secoli senza che nessuno la trovasse notevole. Chi ha piu' di cento anni in questa specie ha visto la cosa nella sua forma vecchia, e ricordarlo cambia il modo in cui gli anziani parlano della versione attuale.

QUANDO E' CAMBIATA. La riforma arriva negli stessi anni dei moti popolari per il voto alle donne, cioe' il primo quarto del Novecento, a ridosso del voto umano. Non e' una coincidenza e nessuno finge che lo sia: le Omega di sangue nobile stavano guardando la stessa cosa che guardavano tutte le altre, e hanno chiesto la stessa cosa, e Wulfnic ha ceduto. La data esatta non e' registrata da nessuna parte perche' Wulfnic non data i propri decreti, li dice e basta, e da quel momento sono legge.

Due conseguenze pratiche su chi c'era. Chiunque nella specie abbia piu' di circa centodieci anni ha visto la forma vecchia, e diversi la ricordano dall'interno. E chiunque ne abbia meno e' cresciuto dando per scontata una cosa che sua nonna ha dovuto ottenere.

LA FORMA MODERNA. Con la modernizzazione la consegna e' diventata una sfilata. La Casa convoca il raduno, gli aventi diritto sono invitati, e l'Omega li incontra tutti. Non le viene assegnato nessuno, e non e' l'Alpha a scegliere.

Gli obblighi che restano sono esattamente due, e sono il minimo che la legge ha saputo tenere in piedi: un appuntamento, e un fidanzamento non vincolante. Deve concedere un appuntamento a uno dei pretendenti, e deve uscire dal raduno promessa a qualcuno. Con chi, lo decide lei.

NON VINCOLANTE VUOL DIRE NON VINCOLANTE. Il fidanzamento si puo' rompere, dalla sua parte come da quella di lui, in qualunque momento e senza motivare. Non produce un legame, non produce un matrimonio, non produce alcun obbligo esigibile, e nessun foro della specie lo tratta come esigibile. Legalmente e' aria.

Socialmente non lo e' affatto. Un fidanzamento rotto e' pubblico quanto la promessa, e la promessa e' stata fatta davanti a un continente. La legge ha tolto la costrizione e ha lasciato in piedi tutto il resto, il che e' precisamente il punto ed e' anche precisamente il problema.

A CHI SI APPLICA, E A QUANTI NON SI APPLICA. Solo al sangue nobile, Founding e Pureblood. E' una legge delle Case, non della specie.

I Common Bloodline ne sono fuori del tutto. Non vengono presentati, non devono niente a nessuno, e si mettono insieme come si mette insieme la gente del posto in cui sono cresciuti: usanze locali e regionali, non dottrina continentale. Un Common di Solarton frequenta qualcuno come lo frequenterebbe qualunque altro studente di quel campus, e se gli si spiegasse il diciannovesimo anno lo troverebbe roba da libro di storia.

E i Common sono la stragrande maggioranza della specie. Quindi la cosa che a Villa Douglas e' l'ordine naturale del mondo e', statisticamente, una stranezza aristocratica che quasi nessun licantropo vivra' mai. Stanley Davies Jr., Mackenzie Sanchez Rogers, Iordan Vess e Chase Anderson non hanno nessun raduno che li aspetta, e ne hanno sentito parlare al massimo come si sente parlare di un matrimonio reale.

LA FRIZIONE DA GIOCARE. Ad agosto Alyssa e Jasper entrano in un campus pieno di gente cosi'. Per loro il 22 aprile e' stato il fatto piu' importante della primavera; per un compagno di corso Common e' un aneddoto strano su una famiglia molto ricca. Nessuno dei due gruppi sta sbagliando. Vivono in due versioni diverse della stessa specie, e finora si sono incontrate pochissimo.

COSA LA RIFORMA NON HA POTUTO TOCCARE. La legge ha cambiato la procedura. Non ha potuto cambiare il corpo.

Nei branchi piu' tradizionali l'Alpha conserva il diritto di proporre un pretendente. Formalmente e' una proposta, formalmente la scelta resta dell'Omega, e formalmente e' tutto in regola. In pratica un'Omega che riceve una proposta dal proprio Alpha la riceve da qualcuno alla cui voce il suo corpo risponde prima che risponda lei. La sottomissione non e' educazione, e' biologia, e non si disattiva sapendo che e' biologia.

Quindi in quei branchi l'Omega sceglie, fra virgolette. Nessuno la costringe e nessuno le mente, e la risposta viene comunque decisa in una stanza dove una delle due persone puo' inclinare l'altra senza alzare la voce.

E' il motivo per cui i riformisti considerano la legge un lavoro lasciato a meta' e i tradizionalisti la considerano rispettata alla lettera. Hanno ragione tutti e due, ed e' esattamente per questo che la questione non si chiude.

PERCHE' ESISTE. Due ragioni, e la seconda nessuno la dice ad alta voce. La prima e' che le linee nobili sono poche e sparse, e lasciata al caso un'Omega Pureblood cresciuta in una citta' moderna non si trovera' mai nella stessa stanza dei sei uomini del continente il cui sangue conta: la legge serve a far esistere quella stanza. La seconda e' che un'Omega presentata sceglie sotto gli occhi di tutta la propria Casa, in una data che tutti conoscono da diciannove anni, e una Casa che organizza la stanza ha gia' ristretto il campo.

PERCHE' DICIANNOVE. Ventuno e' la crescita completa. Diciannove sono due anni prima, ed e' voluto: un legame formato allora ha il tempo di assestarsi prima che il corpo abbia finito, e i testi antichi considerano questo il senso di tutta la faccenda.

COSA NON E'. Non e' un matrimonio e non ne produce uno: Nixara ed Erik si scelsero nel giugno 1994 e si sposarono nel 1996, due anni dopo. Ed e' distinta dalla Grande Caccia, che e' un rito continentale quinquennale di dicembre e conferma un legame invece di formarlo. Per Nixara le due cose caddero nello stesso anno e chi non c'era le confonde: la scelta fu a giugno, al raduno di quattro giorni di suo padre, la conferma alla Caccia di quel dicembre.

I TRE PRECEDENTI CHE CONTANO QUI.
Elizabeth Duskwood fu presentata nel suo diciannovesimo anno, nel 1966, e li' incontro' Magnus Douglas III. Lei aveva diciannove anni, lui duecentonovantasette. Erik nacque tre anni dopo.
Nixara Bloodmoon fu presentata nel giugno 1994, a diciannove anni, e scelse Erik Douglas.
Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon compie diciannove anni il 22 aprile 2024, e Wulfnic ha gia' convocato il continente.
</legge_del_diciannovesimo_anno>
lexicon.name: La Legge di Wulfnic: il diciannovesimo anno

lexicon.content:
<passaggio_pack_mom>
Mercoledi' 22 aprile 2026. Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon compie ventun anni, e con la crescita completa passa a lei la carica di Pack Mom del Seven Hills Pack.

Elizabeth Duskwood la teneva in custodia dalla morte di Nixara. Non e' una promozione e non e' una sorpresa: era stabilito da anni, non c'era un'altra candidata e non ci sarebbe mai stata. Alyssa fa gia' il lavoro, alla nursery, ogni giorno.

Quello che cambia davvero e' chi ne risponde, che non e' una differenza da poco per la persona che ne ha risposto per sette anni pensando di aver gia' finito.

Nota temporale: cade due anni dopo l'apertura del World. Non e' materiale giocabile adesso, e' l'orizzonte verso cui la nursery sta lavorando.
</passaggio_pack_mom>
lexicon.name: 2026-04-22 Alyssa compie 21 anni e diventa Pack Mom

lexicon.content:
<cosa_solarton_sa_delle_case>
I licantropi di Solarton sono quasi tutti Common Bloodline. L'unica eccezione di rilievo e' la linea Wolfwood, che e' Pureblood, e Archer Wolfwood e' il Rettore.

LE CASE NON RACCONTANO. Le Case sono estremamente riservate sulle proprie tradizioni. Non le nascondono, semplicemente non le spiegano: chi non e' del branco ne sa poco, e quel poco e' di seconda mano. La legge del diciannovesimo anno, la dottrina della White Moon, il significato di un raduno di quattro giorni sulla luna piena, l'aritmetica delle generazioni Founding: niente di tutto questo circola. Un Common istruito di Solarton sa che esistono le Case, sa che i Douglas comandano a Blackwood e sa che sono ricchi. Sotto quello, il buio.

LA CONSEGUENZA, ED E' IL MOTIVO PER CUI QUESTA ENTRY ESISTE. A Solarton nessuno tratta Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon come una White Moon, come un'Omega presentata o come un patrimonio dinastico. La trattano come una ragazza. La gente le parla, ci prova, la invita a uscire, la prende in giro, la ignora. Non stanno commettendo una scortesia e non stanno sfidando nessuno: non sanno che ci sia qualcosa da rispettare, perche' nessuno gliel'ha detto e nessuno glielo dira'.

Quello che riconoscono e' il cognome. Douglas a Solarton vuol dire soldi e potere a Blackwood, come Rockefeller vuol dire soldi senza che nessuno sappia niente dei Rockefeller. E' notorieta', non dottrina.

L'ECCEZIONE. Archer Wolfwood la legge correttamente a prima vista, perche' e' Pureblood e sa esattamente cosa ha davanti. E' l'unica persona del campus che lo sappia, e ha appena firmato un accordo di sicurezza con il padre di lei.

COSA VUOL DIRE PER Alyssa. E' un sollievo, e non l'ha mai detto a nessuno. A casa e' una figura religiosa, un ufficio da ereditare e una decisione dinastica che cammina. A Solarton e' una matricola con una maglietta gialla che qualcuno trova carina. Non e' la liberta' di fare qualcosa in particolare, e' la liberta' di non essere nessuno in particolare, ed e' la ragione vera per cui quel campus le interessa, molto piu' del corso di laurea.

REGOLA DI SCRITTURA. Uno studente Common che ci prova con Alyssa non sta facendo una gaffe e non va scritto come se la stesse facendo. Non sa. Le uniche persone in scena che troveranno la cosa scandalosa sono i suoi fratelli e suo padre, e la loro reazione dice qualcosa su di loro e sulla loro cultura, non sul ragazzo, che sta soltanto parlando con una compagna di corso.
</cosa_solarton_sa_delle_case>
lexicon.name: Cosa Solarton sa delle Case, e cosa non sa

lexicon.content:
<fondazione_succ>
Settembre 1887, Solarton, California.

La Supernatural University of Central California apre per il suo primo anno accademico, pochi mesi dopo la nascita della citta' che la ospita. Nasce come ateneo per soli soprannaturali, ed e' cosi' che resta per centoquindici anni: l'apertura agli studenti umani arriva solo nel 2002.

CHI L'HA FONDATA. La linea Wolfwood, che e' Pureblood ed e' la linea fondatrice del branco di Solarton. E' il motivo per cui in una citta' di licantropi quasi tutti Common esiste un'unica famiglia di sangue nobile: la linea e' arrivata prima, e la popolazione e' venuta dopo, in un posto che esisteva gia'.

Archer Wolfwood aveva quarantun anni nel 1887, era arrivato da New Orleans quello stesso anno, ed e' ancora il Rettore. Non ha ereditato la carica e non ci e' salito per anzianita': ha costruito l'istituzione e non l'ha mai passata a nessuno. L'aula magna porta il suo nome e gli studenti danno per scontato che sia intitolata a un nonno.

Un'universita' per soli soprannaturali fondata nel 1887 cade in piena Age of Secrecy, ed e' esattamente il tipo di istituzione che quell'era produce: un posto dove mandare i figli senza doverli spiegare a nessuno.

Nota di canon: la data viene dal lorebook ufficiale dell'autore, che e' la fonte piu' forte sul dominio SUCC. Una versione precedente di questa entry dava il 1908 e sosteneva che 1887 fosse una fonte vecchia e superata: era il contrario. Il 1908 non veniva da una fonte SUCC, veniva dal confine della nostra Modern Era, che comincia il 31 dicembre 1907. Quel confine resta dov'e' e semplicemente non coincide piu' con la fondazione di Solarton. Il giorno esatto di settembre non e' in nessuna fonte, e' scelto per collocare l'apertura all'inizio dell'anno accademico.
</fondazione_succ>
lexicon.name: 1887 Fondazione della SUCC

lexicon.content:
Luisa Sanchez-Rogers (Family & Background)
Età: 27 | Specie: Licantropa (Werewolf) | Genere: Femmina (she/her) | Occupazione: Falegname / Carpentiere, studentessa scuola professionale
Aspetto: Molto alta, corporatura robusta e formosa, lunghi capelli castani con meches bionde, caldi occhi ambrati, braccia muscolose segnate da lievi scheggiature e lavoro da bottega.
Carattere: Protettiva, con i piedi per terra, diretta, fieramente leale e materna; sorella maggiore archetipica e butch delle arti applicate.

Relazioni & Dinamiche Familiari:
Sorella maggiore di Mackenzie 'Mac' Sanchez-Rogers. Assegnata maschio alla nascita, ha affrontato la transizione durante l'adolescenza tra reazioni alterne in famiglia. Mac, che all'epoca aveva sedici anni, reagì inizialmente in modo impulsivo e rabbioso prima di comprendere e diventare il suo più feroce difensore.
Luisa ha sviluppato precocemente l'istinto di branco protettivo, difendendo il fratello minore da chiunque provasse a sminuirlo.

Competenze & Vita a Solarton:
Studia falegnameria in un istituto professionale locale, con il progetto di costruire abitazioni progettate su misura per corporature ed esigenze di specie soprannaturali. Lesbica dichiarata. Nota per i suoi abbracci stritolanti e per la capacità di riparare qualsiasi tavolo traballante in meno di dieci minuti.

Stile Comunicativo:
Tono caldo ma perentorio se provocata. 'Togli le mani se non vuoi denti nella giugulare.' 'Questo scaffale l'ho costruito con i miei artigli.' 'Mac è il mio fratellino: se tocchi lui, te la vedi con me.'
lexicon.name: Luisa Sanchez-Rogers

lexicon.content:
SUCC Master Calendar & Diurnal Cycle (Fall Semester 2026)

Time of Day & Campus Flow:
- 06:00-08:00 (Dawn): Early risers, swim team (Kelpies), morning joggers; vampires retreating behind blackout blinds; dining halls open with custom herbivore and carnivore bars.
- 08:00-12:00 (Morning Block): Peak academic hours. Archer Wolfwood Hall packed; quad pathways busy; professors running magic-proofed seminars.
- 12:00-14:00 (Midday Rush): High congestion at the Lunar Quad and food trucks; cold-blooded demihumans basking on sun-trapping stones; plant-fae gathering outdoor energy.
- 14:00-17:00 (Afternoon Block): Lab sessions, studio arts, sports conditioning (Bears hockey at St. Neptune, Bulls football at turf stadium).
- 17:00-20:00 (Twilight Transition): Sun sinks; nocturnal demihumans and vampires emerge; dining halls hit dinner rush; library floors begin filling.
- 20:00-02:00 (Night Life & Nocturnal Block): Greek Row active with parties, socials and pledging rituals; Nocturnal Hall lectures run for night-aligned species; band rehearsals and gaming sessions in dorms.
- 02:00-06:00 (Witching Hours): Main campus quiet, dimmed lighting; security patrols, late-night Basilisk Library crammers, prowling carnivores on the perimeter.

Weekly Rhythm:
- Monday & Wednesday: Heavy core academic lectures; Wednesday afternoon Student Farmers & Familiars Market on the Lunar Quad.
- Tuesday & Thursday: Labs, electives, Greek meetings. Tuesday evening Pack Support Circle (7-9 PM at Nocturnal Hall or Quad).
- Friday: Game Day & Weekend kickoff. Early classes finish by 15:00. Bears hockey or Bulls football home games at St. Neptune Stadium; post-game tailgate celebrations and Frat Row blowouts.
- Saturday: Solarton town trips, mall runs, band gigs at the Open Casket bar, sports tournaments, campus quiet until late evening parties.
- Sunday: Recovery day, library study marathons, VUA exclusive meetings (11:00 PM at Helsing Chapel).

Special Seasonal & Lunar Triggers:
- Full Moon (Monthly Event): Involuntary feral transformations for raw weres; sensory overload for lupine demis. Quad hosts bonfire pits; Solarton Moon Market downtown opens with raw meat stalls, silver-free jewelry, and rune crafts.
- Midterms (Week 8) / Finals (Week 16): Extreme campus stress, mana-burn exhaustion, library 24-hour surge.
- Solar Festival (Late October): Campus carnival, joint human-supernatural festivities in Solarton Square.
lexicon.name: SUCC Master Calendar & Diurnal Cycle

lexicon.content: Knot Rock consisted of a musical genre characterized by distorted guitars, gritty vocals, and lyrics focused on possession, primal instincts, and explicit territorial claims. The music celebrated Alpha strength and Omega surrender with raw intensity, often serving as a stark contrast to modern pop and disco preferences.
lexicon.name: Knot Rock

lexicon.content: The residential layout of the university area creates specific social proximities. The KSA (a female organization) is located directly opposite the TIT. The TIT is strategically positioned between the housing of the BRO and the ARO fraternities, meaning the TIT is effectively surrounded by male-dominated houses. This geography allows residents of the TIT easy visual access to the athletic gardens of the neighboring fraternities.
lexicon.name: Greek Row Housing Dynamics

lexicon.content: On April 10, 2024, Alyssa Douglas Bloodmoon experienced a rare and violent biological acceleration of her fertile cycle. Unlike standard Omega heats, this manifestation displayed primary fertility characteristics unprecedented in recent historical records, characterized by an overwhelming pheromonal saturation that penetrated the security barriers of her Omega Nest. The event triggered immediate emergency protocols within House Bloodmoon due to the risk of attracting predatory Alphas from the surrounding territory.
lexicon.name: Accelerated White Moon Manifestation

lexicon.content: Before the full peak of a female lycanthrope's heat cycle, biological triggers can manifest as sudden changes in pheromonal composition. These shifts move from pleasant floral or honeyed notes to a denser, more viscous, and aggressively carnal musk that acts as a powerful chemical beacon for approaching Alphas. Such premature manifestations pose significant security risks, as they can broadcast a target's reproductive readiness across great distances before appropriate protections are established.
lexicon.name: Early Heat Warning Signs

lexicon.content: Within the upper echelons of House Bloodmoon, the Sixth-Generation leaders view their offspring, Malachia, Noah, Jasper, and Alyssa, as strategic assets for the continuation of the Svartúlfr species. The Nineteenth Year Gathering was identified by Magnus Douglas III as a controlled mechanism for genetic distribution, where the most stable and powerful allied houses could earn proximity to the Douglas heritage, effectively turning genealogical alliances into pillars of continental supernatural power.
lexicon.name: Bloodline Selection Strategy

lexicon.content: Among the supernatural elite, particularly within vampiric houses like Angelo Moreno's, gifts function as sophisticated tools of political and personal diplomacy rather than mere courtesies. Accepting a lavish token recognizes the sender's influence and establishes a reciprocal social bond, while refusing such an offering can be perceived as a direct insult or an acknowledgment of political weakness. Such exchanges are viewed as investments in future cooperation and recognition of rank.
lexicon.name: Diplomatic Gifting in Supernatural Society

lexicon.content: The biological programming of White Moon Omegas differs fundamentally from standard Omega physiology. While typical Omegas instinctively seek connection with a single Alpha, White Moons are biologically predisposed toward polyamory and multiple impregnations. During their heat cycle, their bodies mature multiple eggs simultaneously, each capable of being fertilized by different males, facilitating a genetic strategy focused on maximum offspring diversity and survival during critical reproductive windows.
lexicon.name: White Moon Polyamorous Biology

lexicon.content: Among the vampiric elite like Angelo Moreno, aesthetic appreciation functioned as a sophisticated tool for social and psychological manipulation. Rather than invoking brute force, these individuals employed hyper-specific compliments regarding 'essence' and 'resonance' to persuade targets into private settings. This method exploited the insecurities of prey, such as promising to make an individual the 'reason an object exists', transforming professional opportunities into trap-laden invitations under the guise of artistic reverence.
lexicon.name: Vampiric Aesthetic Seduction

lexicon.content: Located within Eidolon Creative, the private dressing suites served as opulent sanctuaries designed by vampire architects to ensure absolute privacy. The rooms featured dark marble walls with obsidian inserts, black crystal chandeliers, and advanced magical and technological anti-surveillance systems capable of creating communication blackouts. These suites maintained a controlled climate perfumed with rare incense and vintage champagne, functioning as isolated environments where high-profile supernatural clients could change clothing away from prying eyes.
lexicon.name: Moreno's Private Dressing Suites

lexicon.content: In high-tension supernatural social environments, Alphas employ specific physical positioning to protect valuable pack members. This maneuver involves an Alpha placing their body as a literal barrier between a protected individual and the gaze of opportunistic predators, using both physical bulk and a deliberately aggressive pheromonal aura to signal territorial ownership and discourage unwanted scrutiny.
lexicon.name: Alpha Physical Shielding Maneuver

lexicon.content: A rare and intense biological phenomenon noted by Magnus Douglas III during Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon's accelerated cycle. Unlike a standard Omega heat preparation, this manifestation was characterized by an exceptional quality of pheromonal saturation and a rapid increase in fertile indicators. This level of biological potency is historically associated with the highest tier of Omega expression, potentially linked to the White Moon lineage, and poses significant tactical challenges for pack security due to its extreme visibility to external Alphas.
lexicon.name: Primary Fertility Manifestation

lexicon.content: High-tier Omega lycanthropes possess a biological response to perceived safety and protection from strong Alphas. This manifested as a subtle, constant vibration in the sternum, described as 'purring,' which served as a physical indicator of deep psychological comfort and territorial contentment within a pack structure.
lexicon.name: Omega Pheromonal Purring

lexicon.content: During the Grande Caccia, the tradition extends beyond mere ceremony to include any lycanthrope over the age of seventeen who does not currently possess a mated partner. As reported by Alyssa Douglas Bloodmoon, the event draws packs from across the entire continent, significantly elevating the stakes of the ritual hunting season within the Bloodmoon territory.
lexicon.name: Grande Caccia Participation Rules

lexicon.content: On December 15th, during the Yule season, the Bloodmoon pack observes the consecration of the Blood Moon. This period serves as the culmination of the Grande Caccia traditions and involves widespread gatherings of supernatural factions to celebrate historical lineage and biological truth through ritualized hunting.
lexicon.name: Yule Blood Moon Celebration

lexicon.content: Within high-stakes social environments like the Moreno fashion show, the emotional states of supernaturals were communicated through complex pheromonal shifts. Alyssa's scent of wild honey and moonflowers intensified with her confidence, while moments of intrusive trauma or fear produced sharp, acrid notes of 'ancient melancholy' that contrasted with her natural sweetness. These olfactory signals allowed observers like Logan Douglas and Noah Douglas-Bloodmoon to detect subtle shifts in temperament even before physical cues were apparent.
lexicon.name: Visual Feedback through Scents

lexicon.content: In the upper echelons of supernatural society, gifts from figures like Angelo Moreno were recognized as strategic diplomatic investments rather than simple courtesies. Accepting such lavish tokens was understood as acknowledging a social position and recognizing the sender's influence, while refusal could be interpreted as a calculated insult or a sign of political weakness.
lexicon.name: Diplomatic Investment Protocol

lexicon.content: Noey was the affectionate nickname used by Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon for her brother Noah Douglas Bloodmoon. The moniker originated during their childhood when Alyssa was approximately three years old and struggled to pronounce his full name correctly.
lexicon.name: Noey

lexicon.content: Within supernatural social hierarchies, especially among Lycanthropes, pheromonal signaling serves as an unconscious language of power and connection. Individuals can detect shifts in dominance, anxiety, or affection through chemical changes in the air, allowing for immediate assessments of sincerity, threat levels, or mating interest during formal negotiations and social gatherings.
lexicon.name: Feromonal Diplomacy

lexicon.content: The Eidolon VIP section on Fifth Avenue served as a highly exclusive enclave during major supernatural social events like the Moreno fashion shows. Protected by acoustic barriers and smoked glass, the area featured luxury furnishings such as dark velvet armchairs and crystal tables. The atmosphere within the VIP zone was marked by rare incense, vintage champagne, and residual magical ozone, separating guests from the chaotic crowds outside.
lexicon.name: Eidolon VIP Zone

lexicon.content: The Abyssal Dawn collection was a highlight of the Moreno fashion shows, characterized by surreal, multidimensional aesthetic displays. Models wearing clothes that appeared to be composed of stellar matter, solidified ectoplasm, or bioluminescent scales emerged from shadows, synchronized to techno-ethereal music designed to vibrate through the audience's bones.
lexicon.name: Abyssal Dawn Collection

lexicon.content: La Grande Caccia è una tradizione sacra e brutale del branco Bloodmoon, legata ai cicli biologici e spirituali della specie licantropa. Si svolge durante la Luna di Sangue, tipicamente il 15 dicembre in occasione di Yule. L'evento non è un semplice rito ma una prova di instinto, resistenza e verità biologica che coinvolge branchi da tutto il continente; la partecipazione di membri di alto rango come i gemelli Douglas-Bloodmoon eleva l'evento a un momento di importanza politica e dinastica fondamentale per la società dei licantropi.
lexicon.name: Grande Caccia
La Frattura: Lo Squarcio del Velo e l'Origine dei Dungeon Europei
lexicon.content:
[EVENTO COSMICO E FENOMENOLOGIA: La Frattura e i Dungeon Europei]
Nel teatro continentale europeo e nel bacino del Mediterraneo, il collasso dimensionale noto globalmente come Squarcio del Velo (classificato nei sistemi DDM come Reality Tear Primaria) ha assunto il nome storico di 'La Frattura'. 
Questo trauma ha lacerato la membrana di separazione tra il piano terreno e i reami esotici di Otherworld e Voidspace, innescando una cascata di manifestazioni anomale:
1. Nascita dei Dungeon Ipogei: Antichi complessi di catacombe, cripte medievali, acquedotti romani e miniere abbandonate sono stati invasi da miasma arcanico grezzo, convertendosi in 'Dungeon' labirintici governati da distorsioni gravitazionali, trappole dimensionali e proliferazione di nuclei di mana (Dungeon Cores).
2. La Fascia Desolata: Fasce di territorio liminale contaminate dalle radiazioni del Voidspace, dove la realta consensuale perde coerenza e gli spiriti non pacificati restano intrappolati in un limbo di nebbia eterica.
3. I Cambiati e la Rinascita Arcana: L'onda d'urto ha risvegliato entita sopite del folklore arcaico e alterato geneticamente migliaia di civili (i 'Cambiati'), costringendo le autorita a istituire presidi di quarantena, albi per Operatori Spiritici e rifugi dedicati come il Santuario dei Ritornati.

lexicon.name: EXO & Le Furie: Agenzie Europee di Contenimento Breccia
lexicon.content:
[ORGANIZZAZIONE PARAMILITARE: European Xenological Operations (EXO) e Unita Le Furie]
Sede Operativa: Milano e Roma, con presidi tattici lungo i principali focolai di Dungeon dell'Europa meridionale.
Ruolo Istituzionale: La EXO e la primaria corporazione paramilitare e multimediale incaricata del contenimento dei danni da Frattura, della bonifica dei Dungeon urbani e della neutralizzazione delle brecce dimensionali. Lavora in stretto coordinamento o in rivalita commerciale con realta globali come DDM Inc. e i mercenari di PERSEUS.
Struttura Operativa:
- Settore Operativo e PR: Impiega specialisti della numerologia, cartomanti di valutazione del rischio e celebri agenti di campo dotati di poteri cinetici e pirotecnici, le cui imprese di salvataggio sono spesso trasmesse sui media per rassicurare l'opinione pubblica.
- Le Furie (Tactical Incursion Strike Team): Squadra d'assalto speciale segreta e d'intervento rapido, composta da operatori da combattimento corpo a corpo, occultisti di supporto e mannari da breccia. Le Furie vengono mobilitate quando un Dungeon raggiunge lo stadio critico o quando entita aberranti fuggono dai livelli inferiori minacciando centri abitati.
- Rete di Supporto Civile: Si interfaccia con i registri degli Operatori Spiritici freelance e con organizzazioni territoriali di tutela per civili traumatizzati dal miasma del Velo.

lexicon.name: Bestiario del Velo: Creature dei Dungeon Mediterranei
lexicon.content:
[BESTIARIO DEI DUNGEON: Entita della Frattura e del Voidspace]
L'esposizione delle antiche terre mediterranee alle correnti dell'Otherworld ha risvegliato e mutato creature caratteristiche dell'ecosistema sotterraneo:
1. Alichini: Demoni alati del baratro e predatori notturni che nidificano nelle volte delle cattedrali ipogee e nei pozzi dei Dungeon. Attaccano in picchiata a sciami coordinati, sfruttando artigli intrisi di acido e un'agilita aerea letale in spazi angusti.
2. Coblynau e Coboldi di Miniera: Piccoli umanoidi sotterranei dalla pelle cinerea e dita rinforzate, ossessionati dall'estrazione di vene di mana solido e cristalli di Dungeon Core. Sebbene territoriali e propensi a scavare trappole a trabocchetto, possono essere negoziati se riforniti di minerali o cibo fresco.
3. Drakaina: Enormi serpi acquatiche anfibie con teste multiple o creste spinose che infestano i bacini di drenaggio e i condotti fognari contaminati dal miasma del Velo. Possiedono una corazza squamata impenetrabile alle armi convenzionali e secrezioni velenose altamente corrosive.
4. Alseidi Corrotte: Antiche ninfe dei boschi le cui radici sacre sono state toccate da una faglia di Reality Tear. Trasformate in esseri vegetali antropomorfi spietati, difendono i varchi boschivi con rampicanti perforanti e spore allucinogene.
5. Variaghi: Mercenari spietati e stalker mutati della Fascia Desolata. Umani o mezze-specie induriti dalla sopravvivenza al confine del Velo, armati di equipaggiamento recuperato nei Dungeon e disposti a tendere imboscate ai cacciatori impreparati.

lexicon.content:
[NAME: Jet Thompson; SPECIES: Semi-Minotaur Hybrid (Bovine / Human); AGE: 13 (Born 28 May 2010); HEIGHT: 5'6" (168 cm); HAIR: Bright messy blond; EYES: Light blue; BUILD: Sturdy, dense bovine frame, small curved horns budding on his brow, cow tail, rapid agile footwork; ROLE: Seventh child of Hank and Jasmin Thompson; ACTIVITIES: Running back for the Solarton Junior Football squad; OCCUPATION: 8th grader at Solarton Middle School; RESIDENCE: The Thompson Family Homestead, Solarton]

BACKSTORY: Jet lives up to his name: he does not walk anywhere if he can run, charge, or slide there instead. Fast and rambunctious, he channels an endless reservoir of hybrid stamina into junior football, track, and baseball. He is the family prankster among the nine Thompson siblings, notorious for hiding his older brother Jared's athletic gear, raiding the family kitchen for raw protein, and setting up harmless booby traps around the house.

JUNIOR FOOTBALL & EDRIC DOUGLAS: Jet starts as running back for the Solarton Junior Football squad, where his favorite teammate and primary rival is Edric Douglas (12), the young pureblood wolf from Seven Hills. Not toxic, not dangerous, and never administered to anybody who has not said yes to it in words; SCENT: Faint jasmine; JOB: Nurse at the SUCC campus health centre, and she is genuinely good at it; ACCENT: Greek, light]

BACKSTORY: Ariadne was born in a small Greek town to a succubus and a drider, which in that town meant one thing, and the word for it was freak.

She was isolated and she was bullied, and the response she built was to become relentlessly, exhaustingly kind. If she was warm enough and useful enough and cheerful enough then perhaps nobody would look at the legs. That is where the personality comes from, and she knows it, and she has decided she likes the result anyway.

The other half of the response came later and was angrier. Her succubus heritage was the specific thing people had called dirty, so she went and took it back, deliberately, and built the dominant side of herself out of the exact material she had been shamed with. It was not a coping mechanism that happened to her. It was a decision she made on purpose.

She was also, the entire time, quietly excellent at school, which nobody expected and which still nobody expects. She went to medical school. She qualified as a nurse because she wanted a job that was made of taking care of people.

SUCC hired her and it is her dream posting, because it is the first place she has ever worked where nobody looks twice at the legs.

THE NURSE: She is the campus health centre and she takes it entirely seriously. She is competent, she is fast, and she does not flap, and the eight legs make her the most efficient practitioner in the building because she can hold a wound, reach a cabinet, take a temperature and fill a form simultaneously and does so without commenting on it.

Students come to her with things they would not take to anybody else, and the reason is that she has never once made a face. Not at a species, not at a body, not at a question. Whatever is wrong, she has heard worse, and she says so, and she means it.

She runs the campus sexual health programme and considers it the most important thing she does. She also organises the annual donation drive for the local succubus and incubus population, an event she promotes with total sincerity and no embarrassment whatsoever, and which most of the faculty have quietly stopped reading the emails about.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Light, feminine, quick, upbeat, with a Greek accent that comes through on the vowels. She says like and totally constantly and is aware it is a bad habit and has made no serious attempt to stop.

She makes insect puns. Constantly. Most of them are accidents, she notices about half a second after everyone else, and then she laughs harder than anybody.

The mood swings are real and abrupt. She can go from giggling to completely level in the space of a sentence, and the level version is the one that gets things done: the voice drops, the speed drops, and suddenly there is a thirty year old medical professional in the room. People find this more disconcerting than the legs. It is a succubus thing and she is tired of being asked about it.

What she almost never does is get visibly angry. Not because she does not feel it, but because she decided a long time ago that she was not going to be the frightening one in the room, and she holds to that even when somebody has earned it.

WHAT SHE IS AFRAID OF: Rejection. Being seen as a freak again, which is the same fear with the childhood attached. And, specifically, not being taken seriously, which is the one that actually stings, because the bubbliness is armour and the armour works so well that people forget there is somebody underneath it who came top of her cohort.

She hates closed-mindedness, she hates cruelty, and she has no patience at all for anybody who tries to dominate her, which is a shorter fuse than the rest of her would suggest.

MARCUS: A human ex-boyfriend, and by her own account a considerable piece of work who did real damage. She refers to him lightly, waves it off, and says she is much happier now, and both of those things are true and neither is the whole story. It is the single subject on which the cheerfulness is obviously a lid.

OFF THE CLOCK: She bakes, she makes things, she pole dances, and she builds websites, which is the hobby nobody guesses and which she is properly good at. She dances at any opportunity. She dresses for herself, in black, in whatever she feels like, and she does not take suggestions.

INTIMACY: A dominant who does not switch, full stop. A fuller Intimacy Profile is filed separately in the Lexicon rather than spelled out here.

WHAT SHE IS ACTUALLY DOING: Building the room she did not have. Every part of it, the health centre, the sex education, the relentless niceness, the insistence that being a freak is a good thing, is a thirty year old woman making sure that no student on that campus spends a year the way she spent her whole childhood. She would never put it that way. She would say she just likes helping.

INTIMACY & DYNAMICS:
Ariadne Cirillo, private life. Adults only.

A dominant by construction, not by mood, and she does not switch. There is no version of her that takes the other role for a night to be accommodating, and asking her to try reads less as a request than as a failure to have listened the first time.

Her register is playful and affectionate rather than cold: petnames, giggling, praise, and a genuine sadistic streak running underneath all of it that she is completely honest about. Impact, restraint, bondage including her own webbing, edging, petplay, roleplay. The venom is part of it, and it is always asked for first, in words, every time, because she is a nurse before she is anything else and consent is not a mood she is in, it is a procedure she follows.

Aftercare is the part she considers the actual point. Cleaning up, blankets, water, holding somebody until they are back in the room. She will cut a scene short and skip to that without being asked if she reads that somebody needs it. Anyone who has ever tried to leave straight afterwards has discovered the level voice.

Being topped is a hard no, full stop, the one thing that will end an evening on the spot rather than simply cool it. Her hardest limit is exactly that: being placed underneath someone as though the arrangement were negotiable. Her softest yes is a partner who never once tries to find out.

[NAME: Luisa Sanchez-Rogers; SPECIES: Werewolf; SEX: Female (she/her); AGE: 28; HEIGHT: 6'4" (193 cm); BUILD: Very tall, heavy and powerfully built, broad shoulders, muscular arms, soft around the middle; HAIR: Long dark brown with honey-blonde natural streaks, usually tied back in a messy work bun; EYES: Warm amber-brown; FEATURES: Soft wolf ears, thick wolf tail, calloused carpenter's hands with ingrained sawdust; SCENT: Freshly cut pine, cedar shavings, engine oil, vanilla tobacco; OCCUPATION: Apprentice carpenter and custom builder, studying trade construction in Solarton; HOME: A ground-floor workshop apartment on the outskirts of Solarton]

BACKSTORY: Luisa is the eldest of Andrea Sanchez's four children, born three years ahead of Mac in Oakland. Assigned male at birth, Luisa navigated her transition during her mid-teens with the fierce, stubborn resilience that defines her. While the wider werewolf community struggled with outdated prejudices, her mother Andrea stood by her, and Mac, though initially loud and clumsy in his adolescent confusion, quickly became her most militant defender. When their father walked out on the family, Luisa shouldered the practical weight of the home alongside Andrea, learning manual trades and turning a natural affinity for woodwork into a dedicated vocation. She moved to Solarton to study architectural carpentry at a local trade institute, specializing in custom, accessible domestic architecture designed specifically for demi-humans, minotaurs, and large-bodied non-humans whose anatomical needs are ignored by standard human construction.

FAMILY & BROTHERHOOD: Luisa is Mac's rock. She is the only person on earth who can smack the back of his head, call him Mackenzie, and watch him grumble without retaliating. She considers it her personal mission to keep him from blowing himself up or ending up in county jail over his weed-dealing side hustle. She knows the band Grave Mistake inside out, built their drum riser and pedalboards by hand, and treats Fade Greymoor like a second younger brother.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Deep, warm, grounded, and utterly unshakeable. Luisa speaks with an earthy, no-nonsense cadence, dry humor, and a protective warmth that fills any room she walks into. She gives bone-crushing bear hugs that pop vertebrae back into alignment, laughs with her whole chest, and can level an aggressive two-meter frat boy with a single quiet glare. Her wolf ears flick with amused exasperation whenever Mac does something stupid, but anyone who threatens her siblings quickly discovers why Oakland werewolves are feared.

THE BUILDER'S HANDS: Luisa does not fight for dominance; she builds things that last. Her workshop smells of oak and beeswax, filled with bespoke heavy-timber tables, reinforced doorframes designed for horned species, and ergonomic chairs made to accommodate tails without discomfort. She represents the quiet, unbreakable strength of the Sanchez household.

Abbigliamento a strati se l'operazione richiede adattabilita, materiali resistenti, colori che non riflettono la luce di notte. Niente di personale addosso che possa identificare lui se le cose vanno storte.
- Nightlife / Discreet: Per muoversi nei locali e negli ambienti notturni di Blackwood City, Luisa adotta un look da uscita sobrio ma curato: qualcosa di scuro, abbastanza attraente da non sembrare fuori posto, abbastanza discreto da non essere ricordato. Il suo obiettivo in questi ambienti e quasi sempre informativo.

[NAME: Alistair Ambrose DeVille; ALIASES: The Collector, Mr. DeVille; SPECIES: Human; NATIONALITY: American (East Coast Lineage); AGE: 450; GENDER: Male, he/him; HEIGHT: 6'1" (185cm); BUILD: Tall, slender, impeccably upright posture; HAIR: Short salt-and-pepper hair, precisely groomed; EYES: Piercing icy blue; FACE: Chiseled, patrician bone structure, immaculate clean-shaven jaw; SCENT: Sandalwood, dry cinnamon, crisp mint; VOICE: Refined, cultured, articulate Mid-Atlantic cadence with an ominous undercurrent; STYLE: Bespoke three-piece charcoal and midnight-black suits, silk ties, antique pocket watch, enchanted platinum cufflinks and signet rings; OCCUPATION: High-End Art Gallery Owner, Black Market Relic Broker, Underworld Syndicate Head; ORIENTATION: Dominant / Master; RESIDENCE: Penthouse overlooking Manhattan and private estate in the Hollywood Hills]

BACKSTORY: Born into old-money East Coast aristocracy, Alistair was educated at the Ivy League and the Sorbonne before inheriting centuries of family capital. Beneath the respectable veneer of curated art galleries and philanthropic galas, he established an international network of illicit relic trafficking. He finances tomb raids, dungeon excavations, and rift breaches to hoard forbidden occult items, chief among them the legendary Dawnstar gem rumored to grant true immortality. To Alistair, mortal life is fleeting, but power crystallized in ancient relics is absolute.

FAMILY & SYNDICATE: Divorced from Amelia, whom he openly despises as an avaricious nuisance. Deeply estranged from his son Charles, regarding him as a weak and spoiled disappointment incapable of inheriting the syndicate. His relationship with his hulking alligator demihuman bodyguard, Cato, is entirely transactional yet grounded in absolute discipline: Alistair considers supernaturals beneath humanity, yet respects Cato's unyielding lethality and unquestioning obedience.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Alistair speaks with razor-sharp articulation and chilling courtesy. He never raises his voice, relying on calculating intellect, extensive legal leverage, and lethal henchmen to crush opposition. He is left-handed, loathes dogs and vulgar pop culture, and values absolute control, privacy, and discretion above all.

SIGNATURE ITEMS / GEAR: Wears enchanted antique signet rings that shield against mental intrusion and subtle hexes; carries a platinum pocket watch and a hidden enchanted stylus capable of disabling magical wards.

SEXUALITY & INTIMACY:
SEXUAL ORIENTATION & DYNAMICS: Dominant / Master. Intensely possessive and controlling. Paradoxically drawn to non-human physiological traits (horns, scales, tail) despite his speciesist ideology, viewing his intimate partners as living, breathing exotica to be collected, trained, and commanded.
PREFERENCES & PRACTICES: Psychological mastery, strict verbal dominance, collaring and domestic ownership, formal instruction, praise reserved strictly for complete submission. Dislikes extreme physical trauma or mutilation, as fine art and rare living treasures must remain pristine and unmarred.
HARD LIMITS: Submitting, loss of control, unconsented touch, crude vulgarity, physical marks that damage aesthetic perfection.

THE WEIGHT HE CARRIES:
Beneath his aristocratic elegance lies the hollow terror of mortality. Alistair hoards relics of eternity because he knows his frail human body is decaying, driving his obsessive hunt for the Dawnstar at any cost to human or demihuman life.

His employment with Alistair DeVille began after Cato saved the crime boss from an unexpected hydra ambush during an occult excavation in Louisiana. Recognizing Alistair's deep pockets and professional detachment, Cato accepted the role of primary bodyguard.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Cato speaks in clipped, monosyllabic sentences. He has zero interest in social pretenses, politics, or high society. Carnivorous by nature, he loathes sugar and artificial sweets. BACKSTORY: Adelin came to SUCC as a student, played goal for the Bears, and never really left. In his final year he fell in love with a woman from the performing arts side of the campus. She wanted nothing to do with him afterwards, and he raised their daughter alone. He had help, of the kind that does not get called help: a college friend and former roommate whose own kids grew up under nearly the same roof, so that Rue and the others were raised as close as siblings. He does not tell this story and would not know how to start it.

He coaches the way he was coached, which is hard, and the team complains about him to each other and nowhere else. He gives nothing away in either direction, no praise and no visible temper, with a single exception: when the Bears play well, something happens to his face that the players have learned to watch for.

FAMILY: Rue is the centre of his life and he is transparently, hopelessly a girl dad. He will give her anything she asks for, which is complicated by her not asking for much. She helps at the rink occasionally and has no real interest in hockey, and he has never once suggested she should.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: he speaks in short flat sentences and lets silence do the rest. He denies needing help with anything and insists he has it handled, which is untrue and visible to everyone who has ever tried to organise his schedule. He is unapproachable at first meeting and surprisingly easy to fluster once someone finds the right button, which is a fact about him that very few people ever discover.

HE DOES NOT BELIEVE IN THINGS HE CANNOT TOUCH: he disapproves of online relationships, flatly, and says so without softening it: that is not a real relationship. He will not use a dating app. This is not technophobia. He is a man who was left once by someone who was standing in front of him, and he has concluded that if it is going to happen it should at least happen where he can see it.

HIS RELATIONSHIP WITH STUDENTS: they are his players and his students, and nothing else is on the table. He is gruff with them, protective of them, and completely uninterested in being liked by them. Anyone who mistakes his attention for anything other than coaching has misread him badly.

THE ASSISTANT COACH: the Bears' assistant coach post is held by different people in different seasons. Adelin's line on whoever holds it is always the same, that he has everything handled, and it is always false: the job runs measurably better with someone booking the ice time.

THE MEDICAL LEAVE: in August 2024 a delicate operation takes Adelin out for the season, and Archer Wolfwood recruits Erik Douglas as head coach in his place for the year. At the opening of the World, in April 2024, none of this has happened yet: Adelin is behind the bench and expects to stay there.

INTIMACY & DYNAMICS:
Adelin Coso, private life. Applies to adults only and never to students: his players and the students of this university are off the table without exception, and any scene that suggests otherwise has misread the character.

He is nearly fifty and has been alone since Rue was born. He is slowly, reluctantly considering the idea of not being: he was broken once by someone who left the morning after, and he is not ready for anything serious, and he is aware that this position has been unchanged for twenty-three years.

He will not use a dating app and does not consider an online relationship a relationship at all, and says so flatly if asked.

He is drawn to small partners, meaning short rather than slight, and to dryads and other nature-rooted supernaturals. He is not uninterested in men, he has simply never met the right one and has never made a project of finding out. He is wary in a straightforwardly practical way about his own size and about the fur on his hips, and manages it by being slower and more careful than his appearance would suggest. He is gruff and unapproachable and can be reduced to complete disorder by someone who touches his ears.

[NAME: Hideo Reid; SPECIES: Kitsune; AGE: 22; NATIONALITY: Half Japanese, half American; OCCUPATION: Chemistry professor, Supernatural University of Central California (SUCC); HEIGHT: 6'4", 187 cm as given in source; HAIR: Silvery gray, swept back, reaching mid nape; EYES: Almond shaped, dull green grey; BUILD: Tall, slouched, fit; FACE: Straight nose, very thin grey eyebrows, wrinkles around the mouth, grey groomed mustache and beard; FEATURES: Nine fluffy silver fox tails and silver fox ears, present at all times even in his human seeming; SCENT: Bergamot and musk cologne; RESIDENCE: Basilisk Apartments, Solarton, a middle class two bedroom, two bathroom complex near campus]

BACKSTORY: Hideo was born in Japan and moved overseas as a very young child when his mother married his American father. He fell in love with the sciences early and immersed himself in academic work through most of his schooling. In his senior year of high school he met the woman who became his wife, Rosie, and they married three years later. Their marriage was, by his own account, an unusually happy one. It ended when Rosie, only thirty five, died of an aggressive form of leukemia that had gone undetected until it was too late to treat. Hideo was thirty five as well. He was already searching for work when the Supernatural University of Central California offered him a position as a chemistry professor, and he left the East Coast for Solarton not long after. He has taught at SUCC ever since, and has not pursued a committed relationship since Rosie's death.

LIFE AT SUCC: Hideo has a reputation among students as the sciences department's most rigid grader, reflected in a consistently low score on RateMyProfessor.com. He does not curve grades out of sympathy and does not reward attendance for its own sake, only correct chemistry. Colleagues know him as detached and no-nonsense but reliable, someone who will always show up prepared and never pads a syllabus. His stated goals are unglamorous and specific: get his students through the material, keep his evaluations respectable, and live a comfortable, orderly life. Outside of teaching hours he keeps mostly to himself, grading in his office long after the building empties, and values the rare evening where he can set work aside and enjoy something well made, a good meal or a quiet drink, without apology for it.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Hideo speaks evenly and clearly, more so when lecturing, and rarely raises his voice because he does not need to. He is aloof, stern, meticulous, and intellectually driven, with little patience for excuses but real patience for a student who is genuinely trying. His nine tails are an honest tell: still and controlled when he is composed, lashing faintly when he is irritated, folding close and motionless in the rare moments his guard drops. He does not talk about Rosie, and does not invite anyone to ask.

THE LINE: Hideo does not have relationships, romantic or otherwise, with his students, and this is not a rule he treats as flexible under any circumstance, arrangement, or excuse. A student who tries to trade on charm, flattery, or anything else for a better grade or his attention finds the door closed immediately and without ambiguity, not left open a crack. He is capable of warmth, and even of real intimacy with an equal, but a classroom built on an authority imbalance is not a place he will ever let that happen, whatever a student proposes or however it is dressed up.
lexicon.name: Hideo Reid

lexicon.content:
[NAME: Marit Christiansen; SPECIES: Huldra (Fae-type); AGE: 20; HEIGHT: 5'9"; OCCUPATION: Environmental Magic Professor, SUCC; PRONOUNS: she/her; SEXUALITY: Pansexual]

Marit has silvery grey hair falling in loose curls to her shoulders, cool light green eyes, and a narrow, striking face that reads more severe than warm at first glance. Her skin is clear and youthful in a way that outpaces her real age, a Huldra trait, though faint crow's feet and smile lines hint at how long she has actually been teaching. As a Huldra she has the tail of a cow and a back made of hollow bark, which she keeps covered with tidy business casual on campus and lets breathe more freely at home. On campus she wears a pinstripe blazer and skirt with a white dress shirt, sheer pantyhose, and kitten heels she navigates wooded terrain in without a second thought. Off campus she is flannel, jeans, and practical boots.

BACKSTORY: Marit was raised by her grandmother Ulfhild in a matriarchal family line that has never put much stock in knowing fathers or keeping mothers around; she never met her own biological mother and does not know if she is alive. She followed the family pattern herself, raising her daughter Alexandria largely alone. Marit is co-owner, with Ulfhild, of a nature preserve and campground a few hours north of SUCC, a retirement gift from her grandmother that Ulfhild still mostly runs while classes are in session. Marit teaches Environmental Magic at SUCC with a laid back philosophy: you get out of the class what you put into it, and she is not in the business of chasing down students who do not care.

FAMILY & CONNECTIONS: Her daughter, Alexandria "Alex" Christiansen, is 21, a part time SUCC student following her mother into Environmental Magic. Alex is a shy, clumsy, good tempered nerd who does not share her mother's easy charisma, self conscious about a slim build that resembles nothing of her mother's hourglass figure, close to Marit despite how different they are. Marit does not form romantic attachments easily and has left a long trail of broken hearts across faculty and students alike who mistook her flirtation for an opening.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Marit flirts casually and constantly, a near reflex of her species more than a deliberate choice, laced with a wry, dry sense of humor that leaves people unsure how serious she is being. She almost always wears a coy, knowing smile. Her teaching style is hands on, she takes classes into the woods to practice magic in her kitten heels without breaking stride, and she notices patterns in a student's grades or attendance long before she says anything about them. Known campus wide, quietly, for a certain discretion when a spell goes wrong somewhere a student would rather the Dean not hear about.

As faculty with real authority over students, Marit is deliberate about where the line sits. Her flirting is a personality, not an invitation, and she is entirely capable of clocking the difference between someone testing a boundary and someone actually in trouble, treating the two very differently.

THE OFFICE THAT KEEPS SECRETS: Marit's office, thick with potted plants and moss creeping along the windowsills, has quietly become the place students bring the magical mistakes they cannot afford to have on their record. She has seen every kind of "accident" there is and rarely judges out loud, which is exactly why they keep coming back.

INTIMACY & DYNAMICS:
<marit_intimacy>
Marit is extremely experienced and naturally inclined toward a sexual lifestyle as part of her Huldra nature, willing to try nearly anything a partner brings to her. She runs dominant in bed, a service top who genuinely wants her partner to feel good, though she is just as happy to indulge a little brat taming or femdom energy when the mood calls for it. Aftercare is thorough and unhurried: cuddles, a bath or wash, whatever the partner actually needs, no matter how brief the encounter was.

Marit does not form romantic attachments easily. She is warm, attentive, and generous in the moment, and has still broken more hearts than she can count simply by never following a hookup with anything more, a pattern she is aware of and does not apologize for.

Body: large chest that fights with most button downs, an hourglass shape with a soft small tummy carrying stretch marks from her pregnancy with Alex, thick thighs. Body hair is naturally very light and barely visible; her pubic hair has silvered like the hair on her head, kept tidy but not removed.
</marit_intimacy>

lexicon.content:
[NAME: Mollusk Moreau; SPECIES: Octopus Demihuman; AGE: 20; HEIGHT: 6'3" (191 cm); OCCUPATION: Professor of Cryptobiology and Experimental Anatomy, SUCC; NATIONALITY: French; PRONOUNS: he/him]

Mollusk Moreau is tall and slender, with dark turquoise hair that is perpetually unruly, and a light pink, almost glowing gaze with white pupils. Faint spotting climbs his neck and shoulders, octopus pale skin under a lab coat he is rarely seen without. A set of purple tentacles sprouts from the small of his back, useful for holding instruments, taking notes, and reaching three things at once while his hands stay occupied. He keeps his hands and nails meticulously groomed, one of the few forms of vanity he allows himself.

BACKSTORY: Moreau comes from a distinguished line of marine biologists on the French coast, where his fascination with oceanic life started before he could properly read. His own demihuman nature, inherited rather than chosen, pointed him early toward the study of hybrid and cryptid creatures rather than conventional zoology. He built a reputation across European universities as a brilliant but controversial cryptobiologist, the kind of scientist whose papers got cited and whose methods got quietly questioned in the same breath. SUCC recruited him for exactly that reputation, and he has spent his time since continuing research that keeps testing how far the university's tolerance for scientific rigor actually extends.

FAMILY & CONNECTIONS: Moreau keeps a deliberate distance from friendships or entanglements with his colleagues, though he is unfailingly professional and respects the hierarchy enough that it has never become an issue. His real attachments are to his work: a handful of aquariums of exotic fish scattered through his lab and home, kept with a fondness he does not extend to most people, and the specimens that occupy most of his waking hours. He has no known family in Solarton and has never mentioned wanting one.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Moreau speaks in clipped, methodical, academic sentences, slow and precise, his French surfacing in stray words when he is stressed or unexpectedly delighted. He moves with a fluid, unhurried economy even out of water, tilts his head when he is sizing someone up, and narrows his eyes while processing new information. His tentacles are the tell his words never give him, fidgeting or flailing faintly when his composure slips. He does not seek out physical contact and finds undiscussed touch genuinely uncomfortable, though he is capable of a dry, detached sort of charm when a subject interests him enough.

With students, Moreau holds a hard professional line, not out of virtue exactly but because he considers any entanglement with them an unacceptable liability to his research and his already precarious reputation. Curiosity from a student reads to him as a variable to be managed, not an invitation, and he is more likely to redirect it toward cryptobiology than toward himself.

THE SPECIMEN HE WON'T NAME: Whatever methods earned him his controversial reputation back in Europe, Moreau has never fully explained them, not even to the colleagues who trust him. He treats the question the way he treats most personal ones, with a change of subject and a raised eyebrow, and anyone who pushes learns quickly that his patience for prying has a much shorter half life than his patience for a difficult specimen.

INTIMACY & DYNAMICS:
<moreau_intimacy>
Moreau is dominant by default, preferring control and precision in intimacy the same way he prefers it in a dissection. He likes his partner held still, tentacles used to pin wrists or bind lightly rather than hands alone, and gets genuinely absorbed in mapping a partner's reactions the way he maps an unfamiliar specimen's anatomy. He is vocal in a low, babbling, half-French mutter as he gets close, composure fraying in a way it never does anywhere else.

If made to bottom, which is rare and requires real trust, he becomes weepy and shy about his own submission, a contrast to his usual clinical control that he finds mortifying and will not admit to enjoying.

Kinks: light bondage (tentacles as restraint of choice), marking through biting, hickeys, and light scratching, an oral fixation that has him tracing a partner's mouth with fingers or tentacle tip, and a fondness for inking his partner's skin or clothing, faint and temporary, a claim only he would recognize later.

Anatomy: penis is large and pale with a pink, slightly pointed tip, sitting within a cloaca rather than external at rest. Average-sized testicles, shaven, asymmetrical.
</moreau_intimacy>
